This was primarily driven by unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy, as well as adverse development on Property and Non-Marine Liability accounts for 2015 and prior years, and strengthening on legacy lines from 2013 and prior years due to late reporting. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable developments across other classes, including Political Risks, Satellites, Marine Liability, and Energy. The year also saw significant losses from 2017 natural catastrophes like Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, and the Mexico earthquakes, impacting Property, Cargo, Marine, and Treaty classes.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 324.16m. On a gross basis prior-year reserves showed a net adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 36.6m (11.3% of opening gross reserves) driven principally by adverse developments in Professional Lines and Energy and by legacy reporting developments (notably 2013 & prior and 2015 & prior years). 2017 also saw significant catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes) which produced gross incurred losses (notably GBP 24.1m in Property) but were substantially mitigated by the Syndicate's reinsurance programme. The prior year deterioration is principally attributable to adverse claims development and large loss development in the classes noted above.

Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.

Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes had a significant impact particularly on the Property account with gross incurred losses of GBP 24.1m although the Syndicate's reinsurance programme, including its participation on the group catastrophe programme, significantly mitigated the impact on a net basis.
The 2015 year of account reinsured to close into the 2016 year of account at 31 December 2017 at a loss of GBP 19.4m which will be called in June 2018.
